==================
Primitive types
==================

    Sub Main()
        Dim a As Boolean
        Dim b As Byte
        Dim c As Integer
        Dim d As Long
        Dim e As Single
        Dim f As Double
        Dim g As Decimal
        Dim h As Char
        Dim i As String
        Dim j As Object
        Dim k As Date
    End Sub
End Module
